tagline.en_US: Create and run collaborative Elixir notebooks in a browser. The official image includes the runtime; notebook files can be persisted in the mounted /data directory.

description.en_US: Livebook is a web application for writing interactive and collaborative code notebooks. It executes Elixir code on demand alongside rich text formatting, interactive data visualizations, and automated smart cells. Notebooks run in a predictable sequence and are stored as versionable files that integrate easily with source control. Multiple users can also work within the same notebook simultaneously without additional setup.
